nodes.norm_label: error states (network, rate limit, rejected token, refused action)

nodes.label: Git remote to pipeline matching
nodes.rationale: Compare host/owner/repo case-insensitively ignoring protocol, user part and trailing .git so SSH and HTTPS remotes match the same pipeline.

nodes.label: Token sign-in / replace / sign-out
nodes.rationale: Replace validates the new token before overwriting so a failed validation never loses the old token.

nodes.label: Buildkite Builds Panel Spec
nodes.rationale: Developers switch to the Buildkite website to check build status; a right-side panel keeps feedback next to the code. A personal token is used, so it must be stored safely and never leak.

nodes.label: No build step (Orca transpiles on load)
nodes.norm_label: no build step (orca transpiles on load)
nodes.rationale: Orca transpiles panel and worker on load so saving reloads them; a worker reload drops in-memory state, so anything that must persist goes in storage.

nodes.label: Access and permissions model
nodes.rationale: Plugin acts with exactly the token's Buildkite permissions; visibility and action rights are enforced by Buildkite and the panel only hides or reports accordingly.

nodes.label: Token Handling Rules
nodes.rationale: Token stored only in per-plugin secret storage, read only by the worker, never returned to the panel, scrubbed from logs/errors/UI, sent only via HTTPS Authorization header, validated before saving.
